result:
Compiled successfully on the first pass. The test class `HelpFormatterAgentTest` is at `tests/org/apache/commons/cli/HelpFormatterAgentTest.java`, self-contained (JUnit 3.8 `TestCase`, no external helpers), and covers:

- All 8 documented `DEFAULT_*` constants and their implied use as the fresh-instance defaults
- Every getter/setter pair (width, padding, prefixes, separator, arg name, new line)
- `optionComparator` default behavior (case-insensitive alphabetical) and the documented null-reset contract, verified through observable render output rather than internals
- Protected helpers `createPadding`, `rtrim`, `findWrapPos` (including the boundary/-1 case, hard-break case, multi-whitespace tie-break, and non-zero `startPos`), `renderWrappedText` (append semantics, wrap correctness via reconstruction, and continuation-line indentation)
- `renderOptions`/`printOptions`/`printUsage`/`printWrapped`/`printHelp` overloads, including ordering of usage/header/options/footer and the documented `IllegalStateException` when there's no room to print a line

`./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
